adjusts.description: Output state: True calls PSupply.on (':OUTPut:STATe 1'), False calls PSupply.off (':OUTPut:STATe 0')
adjusts.name: output_enabled

facts.text: PSupply stores the VISA resource it is constructed with as self.PS
setVolt writes 'VOLT ' followed by the value
setCurr writes 'CURR ' followed by the value
measureVolt queries 'MEASure:VOLTage:DC?' and returns the resource's reply
measureCurr queries 'MEASure:CURRent:DC?' and returns the resource's reply
The upstream README lists a digital power supply among the instruments it controls over VISA

measures.description: Voltage the resource reports for the output (MEASure:VOLTage:DC?)
measures.name: voltage

measures.description: Current the resource reports for the output (MEASure:CURRent:DC?)
measures.name: current

measures.description: Measure a DC or RMS voltage on a declared channel or terminal pair and return the value with its sampling timestamp and measurement range.

inputs.description: True for the DC sample the supply reports; False (RMS) is not supported by this query
inputs.name: dc

measures.name: measure_voltage

measures.description: Measure current on a declared channel and return the value with its timestamp and range.

inputs.description: Channel or terminal name accepted by the class schema; the upstream class has one output, so the value is not used
inputs.name: channel

measures.name: measure_current
